extracted.intended_audience: students, teachers, and lovers of the French language
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of a free online French learning resource offering lessons, exercises, tools, and assessments organized by proficiency level for self-study and classroom use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lessons by Level
rubrics_metrics.description: Lessons and exercises ranked according to six levels of language proficiency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content is organized by proficiency level so learners can find material matched to their ability; implies use of level-based progression.

rubrics_metrics.name: French 101 (self-study course)
rubrics_metrics.description: Self-study course with lessons, cultural tips, listening exercises, and quizzes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A basic structured course combining explanations, culture, listening practice, and formative quizzes for beginners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily Practice Ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: Regular practice is key – just 15 minutes a day can make all the difference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommends short, consistent daily practice as a core learning strategy; emphasizes frequency over long sessions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grammar
rubrics_metrics.description: Parts of speech, sentence structure, conjugations, and all the other rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive grammar coverage intended as reference and instructional material for constructing correct French.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pronunciation
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters, letter combinations, liaisons, accents, contractions, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on phonetics and pronunciation features specific to French, useful for spoken accuracy and listening comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocabulary
rubrics_metrics.description: Themed vocab lists + wordy lessons: synonyms, prefixes, abbreviations…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides thematic word lists and deeper vocabulary lessons (word formation, synonyms, abbreviations) to build lexical knowledge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quizzes and Tests
rubrics_metrics.description: Assorted quizzes, online proficiency test, and info about official certification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes formative quizzes and a proficiency test; also supplies information on official certification pathways, enabling assessment and credentialing.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Subjunctivisor
rubrics_metrics.description: Does [insert verb | expression | conjunction] require the subjunctive?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A focused decision tool to determine when the subjunctive mood is required; useful for resolving specific grammatical questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verb Tables
rubrics_metrics.description: 1,600+ French verbs conjugated into all the simple tenses and moods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensive conjugation reference covering many verbs and tenses/moods for both study and reference use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Langua French Chat
rubrics_metrics.description: Practice speaking French any time of day or night with a human-like AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides spoken-practice opportunities via an AI chat partner to rehearse conversation and speaking skills outside a classroom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress with Lawless French
rubrics_metrics.description: Find your level to get a personalized study plan and learning resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Diagnostic or placement to determine learner level followed by a tailored study plan and curated resources for targeted progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Frantastique
rubrics_metrics.description: Story-based learning with daily lessons, dialogues, historical notes, and comics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An alternative pedagogical approach emphasizing narrative, daily micro-lessons, dialogues and cultural/historical context to engage learners.

rubrics_metrics.name: French Language Skills (core skills)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site addresses the four core language skills; resources and exercises are mapped to these skill areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: French proficiency test (site-provided)
rubrics_metrics.description: French proficiency test (listed under Quizzes and Tests).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An online tool to assess overall proficiency, presumably used to place learners into levels and measure progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay up to date / Updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Stay up to date with Lawless French.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscription or update mechanism to receive site news, new lessons, or feature announcements to support ongoing learning.
